doc.title: Database Decision REVISED: Switching from Zypherion to Meridian

footing_cases.author: Xena ExpertGH

footing_cases.when: The memo's own editorial prose outside Quinton's quoted words.

segments.exact:
We evaluated Zypherion further and found critical gaps in
its streaming ingestion.
We are now switching to Meridian instead.
segments.note: Announces the switch decision; declarative force glossed — the saying performs the change of decision.

segments.exact: Meridian handles both batch and streaming natively.
This supersedes the previous Zypherion decision.
segments.note: Editorial prose performing supersession of the prior decision.
